items.title: People with Long COVID demand pause of McMaster University clinical trial
items.summary:
The trial, run by researchers at McMaster University in Canada, is testing the Lightning Process, a pseudoscientific mind-body program that outside experts have heavily criticized.
The post People with Long COVID demand pause of McMaster University clinical trial first appeared on The Sick Times.
